description: One stereo channel of a modular mixer: it adds its two signals to a stereo bus that runs through a row of these

params.text: Turns down one side of the channel, the left side at one end of its travel and the right side at the other
Multiplies the incoming signals by 0 to 2, leaving them unchanged at the centre
Silences every other channel of the solo group; its lamp blinks while it is on
Turns the channel on and off; its lamp is lit while the channel is on

inputs.text: A rise here turns the solo on or off
A rise here turns the channel on or off
A voltage here takes over from the PAN knob, 0V fully left, 5V centred and 10V fully right
A voltage here takes over from the GAIN knob, 0V to 10V across a multiplier of 0 to 2
Joins the channel to a solo group; 10V arriving here silences the channel unless its own SOLO is on
The left side of the stereo bus arriving from the channel before this one
The right side of the stereo bus arriving from the channel before this one
The left signal this channel adds to the bus
The right signal this channel adds to the bus

outputs.text: 10V while this channel is soloed, to be carried on to the next channel of the solo group; link the last one back to the first
The left side of the bus with this channel's share added
The right side of the bus with this channel's share added
A copy of this channel's left signal after gain, on, solo and pan, for feeding an effect
A copy of this channel's right signal after gain, on, solo and pan, for feeding an effect

notes: the column of lamps beside the gain control is a meter, one lamp for each volt to 10V, and the topmost one stays lit for a moment once the signal passes 10V
the stereo bus runs through the row: the two bus outputs of this channel go into the bus inputs of the next channel, and the last channel in the row goes into MASTER

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
